convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for VininI_Trend indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) containing custom smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic not available as built-in MT5 indicators.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for calculation
derived_values.formula: GetStartBars(MA_Method1, Length1+MA_Step*(MA_Count-1), Phase1) + GetStartBars(MA_Method2, Length2, Phase2) + 3 + SignalBar

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

other_exits: In BREAKDOWN mode: long position closes when indicator drops below DnLevel (BUY_Close=true when SellPosClose enabled and Value[1]<DnLevel)
In TWIST mode: long position closes when indicator direction changes from up to down (Value[1]>Value[2])
Exit permissions controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input booleans

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM values treated as fixed lot size (MM=-0.1 means 0.1 lots), positive MM values treated as deposit fraction/share per deal

custom_logic_notes: Two distinct entry modes selectable via AlgMode enum: BREAKDOWN mode enters when indicator crosses above UpLevel (buy) or below DnLevel (sell), requiring Value[1] beyond level AND Value[0] on the other side (crossover confirmation). TWIST mode enters on direction change of the indicator itself: buy when Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator turning up), sell when Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2] (indicator turning down). Signal timing uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation if CopyBuffer fails. Entry/exit permissions are independently configurable via BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose booleans.
python_conversion_notes: The VininI_Trend custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python since it uses custom JJMA and other non-standard smoothing algorithms from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. The indicator applies a two-stage smoothing: first a stepped moving average chain (Length1 incremented by MA_Step for MA_Count steps using MA_Method1), then a final smoothing with MA_Method2. The custom Applied_price_ enum includes non-standard price types (PRICE_SIMPL_, PRICE_QUARTER_, PRICE_TRENDFOLLOW0_, PRICE_TRENDFOLLOW1_) that also need implementation. TradeAlgorithms.mqh contains BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions and GlobalVariableDel_ which handle position management - these need to be reimplemented or replaced with standard Python trading framework equivalents. The MM parameter dual-mode sizing (negative=lot, positive=fraction) must be preserved. The IsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh and LoadHistory function need Python equivalents. No digit adjustment logic is present in the EA code itself - SL/TP are used as raw point values.
